items.title: Abby Foster Interview, 1960-06-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...in case you find Sonny Petit... [INTERVIEWEE] Well I'll find him to see him.

ctx.x: Yes, I certainly do. We'll put that on another little slip later on we fill out. So I can contact you again in case you find Sonny Petit or some of the other fellas too.
Well I'll find him to see him.
